_comment: The org's issue types (design 6.6), one per issue form; the form's `type:` must name one of these. apply-rules.py creates or updates them, verify-settings.py checks them. Colours are GitHub's: gray, blue, green, yellow, orange, red, pink, purple.

types.name: Task
types.description: Work a person does, in any discipline

types.name: Feature
types.description: Not used: features go through an Intent

types.name: Intent
types.description: Work for an agent to do through Peras

types.name: Audit finding
types.description: A problem found by a phase 1 audit

types.name: Decision
types.description: A question for the partners to decide

types.name: Process failure
types.description: A mistake in how work is done, and what now prevents it by code
